description: Search or list approved apps. Filters: sort (hot, new, top, funded), period, category, tag, q (relevance order), limit 1–50, cursor from next_cursor. Returns AppSummary objects with absolute urls.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor.

period.description: day, week, month, year, or all. Used only when sort is top.

q.description: Full-text query, at most 200 characters. Empty or punctuation returns no apps.

sort.description: hot, new, top, or funded. Default hot. Ignored when q is set.

tag.description: Tag of 1–24 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.

name: search_apps
title: Search apps
